assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: exclusion of people from beneath elevated work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report during transfer operations on HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9403 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 21 January 2012 a hazard report was recorded on HO-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
